profile.headline: Senior QA Software Developer In Test (SDET) at C2 Solutions
profile.jobTitle: Senior QA Software Developer In Test (SDET)
profile.summary:
Mr. Brown is a full stack SDET that has over 30 yrs experience in software development and former CEO of Reflective Software Inc.  (S. Portland, ME).  He has also been a consultant for numerous Fortune 500 companies.   His proficiencies and certifications include Agile Scrum and Kanban, RUP, CMM, CMMI, Accenture ADM,  PMI principles, OO Design, C, C++, Python, Javascript (including NodeJS), Rational Rose, Rational Robot, Rational ClearCase, Rational Requisite Pro, Selenium, Python, PyWinAuto,  UML MOOSE  (similar to UML) Java, InstallShield SQL Server SP and Triggers Windows NT Solaris and Macintosh OS platforms,  WinRunner, LoadRunner, QuickTest Pro, TestComplete, TestExecute,  QA Symphony (qtest), Rational Robot, Rational Test Manager, Robot Framework, Load Runner, Silk Performer,  WebScraping, Postman and MS Project.   Mr Brown also has experience with penetration and vulnerability testing techniques using NMAP, Nessus and its relation with the NVD and US-Cert information bases.

Specialties: Software test automation (Robot Framework, Python and Postman API),  test management,  UML, fuzzy logic search methods.   Design of Experiments  (DOE), Agile Scrum framework, penetration test scanning.   Mr. Brown is also a certified Agile Scum Master and has helped facilitate a number of successful transformations.

Along with his onshore technical skills,  Mr Brown also holds a USCG Masters Captains license (100 tons GRT) with towing and sailing vessel endorsements.  He has been a professional captain on vessels up to 90' on the Atlantic and Great Lakes since 1981.
